functions.desc: Create a pivot table. key_col=row labels, pivot_col=column labels, value_col=values, agg=sum/avg/count/min/max

args.name: row_field
args.desc: Column index for row labels in the pivot table

args.name: col_field
args.desc: Column index for column labels in the pivot table

args.name: value_field
args.desc: Column index for the values to aggregate

args.name: [aggregation]
args.desc: Aggregation function: SUM, AVG, COUNT, MIN, or MAX (default SUM)

args.name: [has_headers]
args.desc: TRUE if the first row contains column headers

functions.doc: 透视表。row_field=行标签列, col_field=列标签列, value_field=值列（列号均为 **0-based**，首列=0）。aggregation=`sum/avg/count/min/max`（默认 SUM），has_headers=首行是否表头（默认 TRUE）。聚合仅统计**数值类型**单元格：文本（含数字文本如 `"10"`）与空白跳过（Excel SUM 语义）；错误值传播 NaN
